about: monster_art: every wrong shape is a mod error naming the entry, and the entry is left out (a good monster in the same block is kept).
expect_mod_errors: unknown part 'tail'
unknown monster 'dragon'
start has no head
needs a body
mixes fill and variants
pair needs fill
empty list
"none" inside a list
unknown key 'standard'
unknown key 'world'
placement must be 0, 1 or 2
pen takes no pair
'BAD ogre hand no line' monster_art.ogre.loop: an ogre's
'BAD ogre ej falls back to a lineless loop' monster_art.ogre.ej: an ogre's
no loop body to fall back on
gnx:nope
'BAD monster_art not object': monster_art must be an object
'BAD monster not object' monster_art.goblin: must be an object
'BAD phase not object' monster_art.goblin.loop: must be an object
'BAD placement not object' monster_art.goblin.placement: must be an object
'BAD placement block not object' monster_art.goblin.placement.1: must be an object
'BAD anal not object' monster_art.goblin.anal: must be an object
'BAD ogre anal no line' monster_art.ogre.anal.loop: an ogre's
'BAD ogre placement no line' monster_art.ogre.placement.1.loop: an ogre's
'BAD ogre placement anal no line' monster_art.ogre.placement.1.anal.loop: an ogre's
'BAD empty part' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: empty part
'BAD comment only part' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: empty part
'BAD anal in anal' monster_art.goblin.anal: anal is not allowed inside anal
'BAD list in list' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: a list inside a list
'BAD number sprite' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: a sprite must be a name
'BAD hand_xscale number' monster_art.goblin.start: hand_xscale is
'BAD hand_xscale wrong' monster_art.goblin.loop: hand_xscale is
'BAD body none in a variant' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: "none" is not allowed here
'BAD hand_xscale on ej' monster_art.goblin.ej: hand_xscale is
'BAD pair line not a name' monster_art.goblin.loop.body: a sprite must be a name, not 7
unknown variant 'leg_7'
this monster is not in the cell's mon_types
'BAD empty mon_types' monster_art.ogre: the game never calls this monster to this cell
'BAD no mon_types' monster_art.ogre: the game never calls this monster to this cell
'BAD ogre not in mon_placements' monster_art.ogre: the game never calls this monster to this cell
unknown monster 'wyrm'
'BAD undeclared idle_start' monster_art.goblin.idle_start: not played on this cell
'BAD undeclared start_loop in anal' monster_art.goblin.anal.start_loop: not played on this cell
'BAD undeclared loop_ej in placement' monster_art.goblin.placement.1.loop_ej: not played on this cell
'BAD undeclared ej_birth in placement anal' monster_art.goblin.placement.1.anal.ej_birth: not played on this cell (needs physical.intermissions.ej_birth
'BAD undeclared ej_end' monster_art.goblin.ej_end: not played on this cell (needs physical.intermissions.ej_end and independent places)
'BAD ej_end without places' monster_art.goblin.ej_end: not played on this cell (needs physical.intermissions.ej_end and independent places)
'BAD other intermission declared' monster_art.goblin.idle_start: not played on this cell
'BAD ej_birth without birth' monster_art.goblin.ej_birth: not played on this cell (needs physical.intermissions.ej_birth, which only a cell with a birth scene plays)
'BAD ej_end without places': intermissions.ej_end works only with scr_slot_h_gnx_places
'BAD ej_birth without birth': intermissions.ej_birth is ignored: the captive does not give birth
Cell 3 monster_art.goblin.idle_start: not played on this cell (a vanilla cell has no intermissions)
Cell 3 monster_art.goblin.ej_end: not played on this cell (a vanilla cell has no intermissions)
